mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the federal funds rate below 0.4% for the past 6 months signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in UNRATE below 4.0% for the past 6 months indicates a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in strong labor periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden monthly increase in FEDFUNDS above 0.4% triggers expectations of monetary tightening, raising long-term interest rates and reducing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 0.4 in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 3-month window.
